content.text:
Here are good **free online auto repair estimate** options:

### For mechanical repairs
- **RepairPal Estimator** — good for common repairs like brakes, alternator, radiator, starter, A/C, etc. Gives price ranges by vehicle and ZIP code. ([repairpal.com](https://repairpal.com/estimator/repair-services?utm_source=openai))
- **YourMechanic Instant Estimates** — free quotes for many maintenance/repair jobs, with parts/labor breakdown and mobile mechanic booking options. ([yourmechanic.com](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates/?utm_source=openai))

### For body damage / collision estimates
- **Instant Estimator** — free online auto body repair estimates; can estimate scratches, dents, collision damage, and connect you with local body shops. ([instantestimator.com](https://www.instantestimator.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Otto Fix It** — lets you upload a photo of damage and get an AI estimate, then compare nearby shop quotes. ([ottofixit.com](https://www.ottofixit.com/free-car-repair-estimate?utm_source=openai))
- **CarAid** — photo-based repair estimates with AI plus human review; offers a free slower option. ([caraid.us](https://www.caraid.us/?utm_source=openai))

### Quick tip
Online estimates are best for a **ballpark price**. Final cost can change once a mechanic or body shop inspects hidden damage, diagnostic codes, rust, sensor/calibration needs, or OEM vs aftermarket parts.

If you tell me your **year/make/model**, **ZIP code**, and what needs fixing — or describe the damage — I can help you estimate a reasonable price range.
